name: Austin Housing
source_text: Active buy-box: real estate acquisition. Screen properties, not operating companies. Markets: Austin, Texas. Asset types: Multi-family, Single-family. Price: USD 2,000,000–30,000,000. Strategy: Value-add. Exclude: office, hospitality. Units: not constrained.
screening_rules: Do not reclassify an asset type
Leave mandate fit blank if asset type, market, or asset-type size measure is unknown
Keep mandate fit, transaction status, and seller interest separate
No public listing is proof of off-market status
Seller interest is unknown unless a source states owner intent
